conclusion_zh: 真实失败定位于初始bank0完成后的报告reducer严格Q相等检查，尚未G/AD。父/draw顺序和chunk划分静态正确；实际差值未落盘，不能确认仅为浮点舍入。可用013已登记的1e-7V实际A重复残差门作最小工程修复，保留逐draw实际A/mu/v，先落盘再门判，禁止替代或广播。

confirmed_execution.explanation: The failing require is outside Store.call, after all charged bank operations completed. Thus native failure with an all-completed journal is consistent.

lineage_and_batch_analysis.append_and_reshape: Each sequential chunk appends q/mu, then concatenate and reshape(6593,4).
lineage_and_batch_analysis.inference_zh: 没有静态错位或父跨chunk证据。因而不能把本次失败直接解释为同父跨不同batch大小；真实设备行位置/算子数值差异仍属候选解释。

model_path_analysis.Q_mu: canonical_charge008(actual frozen A signal_pre) in float64 before charge multiplier
model_path_analysis.actual_A_path: Frozen deterministic baseline with zero physical/local latents, sample-wise GroupNorm/Conv/FiLM and no observed BatchNorm/Dropout path; new shape/charge latents do not setQ_mu.
model_path_analysis.exact_mu_comparison_implies: At least one saved-in-memory per-draw Q differs from its parent first draw; finite positive output guards were already passed.
model_path_analysis.does_not_imply: No magnitude, affected parents, waveform residual, ULP profile or CUDA-kernel cause follows from the boolean failure.

saved_calibration.inference: One-parent-per-row calibration passed positive Q and analytical1LSB initialization. It does not quantify the later duplicate-draw A/Q residual.

partial_evidence.save_order: bank0 BASELINE100 was written before the strict check; CHARGE_PREADC_MOMENTS, CHARGE_SEMANTICS, HARD_ROWS and REPORT saves follow the check and were not reached.

engineering_gate_recommendation.applicability: Same frozen A on the same exact SOURCE-parent/draw identities, full384 actual float64 voltage rows. Reuse the helper unchanged; the limit is execution replay tolerance, separate from scientific response T.
required_save_before_gate: Actual A384 rows for every parent/draw, actual model Q_mu per draw and q_sig per draw, per-draw v=a*mu+b*mu², and parent/draw/ID metadata
A repeat diagnostic summary with max/RMS/bit differences and affected identities, input byte-identity and exact lineage status
engineering_gate_recommendation.exact_guards: Verify source IDs unique, repeat/tile order, count/dtype/finite-positive fields, and exact same-parent SOURCE input bytes separately; failure remains hard. Use all actual outputs without substitution.
engineering_gate_recommendation.numeric_guard: Write evidence first, then fail if any full-A point residual exceeds the existing1e-7V gate. A Q-only allclose is insufficient: cancelling waveform errors can hide in the integral.
prohibited: No default np.allclose or unregistered tolerance
No change to actual A, no broadcasting first draw or mean A
No substitution of mu[:,0] or mean(mu) into q law or its denominator
No claim that the already failed attempt was within tolerance

canonical_Q_bound.finite_sum_note: For stored float64 A and a normal IEEE round-to-nearest sum without overflow/subnormal exceptions, include a conservative sum-rounding term gamma255*(L1(A_d)+L1(A_ref)); gamma255=255u/(1-255u),u=2^-53. Record actual Q residual and actual reduction-consistency residual. Do not turn the derived integral bound into an unrelated learned/scientific tolerance.

correct_draw_specific_statistics.conditioning: Condition on every retained actual mu_d and independent charge z_d, D=4.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.report_mean_only: E(mean_d q_d)=mean_d mu_d; this descriptive report center never replaces actual per-row modelmu.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.expected_sample_variance_ddof1: E[s_q²]=mean_d(v_d)+samplevar_d(mu_d,ddof=1). The second term is deterministic numerical row-mean spread and must not be labelled physical charge variance.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.theoretical_sample_mean_MCSE: sqrt(sum_d v_d)/D; variance of sample mean=sum_d v_d/D². No samplevar(mu) term is added when conditioning on the retained deterministicmu layout.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.draw_specific_residual_second_moment_ddo: mean_d((q_d-mu_d)²) has expectation mean_d(v_d); do not subtract the realized residual mean or relabel the numericmu spread as physical variation.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.empirical_MCSE: Keep sqrt(samplevar(q,ddof=1)/D) if reported, label it the empirical draw-based value and distinguish it from the analytical conditionalMCSE.
correct_draw_specific_statistics.inference_limit: Repeated model draws remain Monte Carlo samples of the generator. Unpaired REAL does not supply same-input conditional variance truth.

artificial_checks_executed.method: stdlib manufactured integer lineage, count arithmetic and non-neural hand-written384-point arrays only

focused_artificial_tests_for_next_patch: Exact repeats, sub1e-7 A perturbations, above-gate A perturbations and equal-Q cancelling shape errors; persist diagnostic before any rejection
Parent/draw permutation, input-byte mismatch, missing row, wrongdtype and nonfinite/nonpositive fields must reject exactly
Keep actual per-drawmu and v untouched, verify mean(v)+samplevar(mu) and sqrt(sum(v))/D with controlled unequalmu arrays
Run evaluator save path on manufactured arrays without CP/real data/newNN; verify saved A/mu/v and failure evidence order
restart_review_boundary: This is a diagnosis review, not a repaired-source/frozen-package or restart approval. Root has separately authorized a minimal driver storage/reducer and new runtime-root repair; its final diff/tests/pins require independent review. No retrospective rerun of the failed private arrays is needed to choose the already registered engineering limit.
